default: off; absent daemon search-mode file creates no native search runtime
activation: explicit complete hash-bound registry/policy + runtime/load/search configuration and existing scoped service reader authorization
serving: Only a selected native packed bundle passing the existing final authorization, revision/liveness, audit and cancellation transaction is marked served. Otherwise existing baseline fallback or request rejection applies.
policy: Caller must select an already registered typed policy; scalar or validated optional fast/slow. No new rate, weight or accepted scientific coefficient inferred.
observation: Mode, contract digest and bounded hashed refs distinguish general serving from immutable legacy scalar shadow and fast/slow on. Served means successful Search return, not HTTP delivery, model use, task success or causal effect.
cost_and_writes: Existing usage receipt/audit only; no new native state, outcome or learning writes on search.
privacy: No raw query, source body, credentials or private path in observations.
stages: Existing immutable sys-native-service-stages-v2 final-fence stages and unknown semantics are retained.
